evidence_items.explanation: LLMbda supplies machine-checked information-flow guarantees and a banking-agent evaluation, providing material progress against the categorical pessimism. Its stated modeling limits, policy relaxations, and two successful attacked runs prevent treating it as independent establishment of overall security and trustworthiness.
